details:
Version:
VRChat 2020.3.3, build 992
Description of the bug:
VRC_Sync Video Stream's auto start does not work.
When I place a VRC_Sync Video Stream in our world with the Auto Start checkbox turned on, it does not start playing automatically.
This is occurring since VRChat 2020.3.3, build 992.
When I check the log, youtube-dl is working, but then the playback log does not appear. Now I have to send a manual Play or Next RPC to start the playback.
title: [Build 992, SDK2] VRC_Sync Video Stream's auto start does not work.
